declare

 alert_text varchar2(500);
 chp_sysdate date;
begin 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 alert_text := 'Do you really want to release the Interdiction? '||
 '['||:exist_inter_blk.inter_code||'] '||
 nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'')||' '||
 nvl(:exist_inter_blk.reason_code,'');

 Set_Alert_Property('release_alert', ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, alert_text);

 rel_alt := show_alert('release_alert');

 if rel_alt=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 update donor_interdictions set release_date = chp_sysdate, --:exist_inter_blk.term_date, --modified on 05/21/2011; AV; IM:5597
 release_user = :banner.user_id
 where transaction_id=:exist_inter_blk.transaction_id
 and inter_code = :exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and inter_type=:exist_inter_blk.inter_type
 and trunc(term_date) =trunc(:exist_inter_blk.term_date)
 and nvl(originated_from,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'LPL')
 and nvl(reason_code,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.reason_code,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_id,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_id,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_mode,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_mode,'LPL');

 commit;
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 clear_block;
 execute_query;

 end if; 

 
end;

PROCEDURE populate_term_blk IS
 descr varchar2(50);
 chp_sysdate date;
 v_local_time date;
 cursor c1(pl_chp_sysdate in DATE) is
 select inter_code,
 inter_type,
 insert_date,
 term_date,
 insert_user,
 release_date,
 release_user,
 originated_from,
 reason_code,
 group_mode,
 group_id
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and pl_chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,pl_chp_sysdate+1))
 and pl_chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,pl_chp_sysdate+1) )
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD')
 and trunc(term_date)<trunc(pl_chp_sysdate)
 order by insert_date desc ;
 

begin

 /* set insert allowed * delete allowed properties true to enable to
 insert the data */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

 go_block('term_inter_blk');

 /* populate the block with terminated interdicions */
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 


 for z in c1(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 select inter_desc
 into descr
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=z.inter_code; 
 
 :term_inter_blk.inter_code := z.inter_code;
 :term_inter_blk.descrip := descr;
 :term_inter_blk.inter_type:=z.inter_type;

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, z.insert_date, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := z.insert_date;
 end if; 
 
 :term_inter_blk.eff_date := to_char(v_local_time);--to_char(z.insert_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'); --modified on 05/16/2011; AV
 :term_inter_blk.term_date := z.term_date;
 :term_inter_blk.insert_user := z.insert_user;
 :term_inter_blk.release_user := z.release_user;
 :term_inter_blk.release_date := to_char(z.release_date,'mm-dd-yyyy');
 :term_inter_blk.originated_from := z.originated_from;
 :term_inter_blk.reason_code := z.reason_code;
 :term_inter_blk.group_mode := z.group_mode;
 :term_inter_blk.group_id := z.group_id;
 next_record;
 end loop;

 /* delete the blank record created at the end of the block */

 delete_record;
 first_record; 

 /* set the insert allowed and delete allowed properties to false */

 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('term_inter_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.close',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 

END;
